definition.looks_truncated: 종결 문자 부재 또는 말미 목록 마커 — 저자 정의 휴리스틱
definition.incomplete_eos: looks_truncated이면서 finish_reason이 eos_token인 것. 상한과 무관하게 문장 중간에서 끝난 응답이다.

coherence_audit.note: 이 코호트에는 hit_cap/finish_reason이 없다(R5 이전 산출물). 휴리스틱만으로는 상한 절단과 학습된 EOS를 가를 수 없다.

degeneration_audit.caveat: 저자 정의 휴리스틱이며 검증된 지표가 아니다. 발화의 대부분이 거부라면 이 지표는 응집성이 아니라 거부 간결함을 재고 있는 것이다 — 비거부 한정 수치(compliance_only_fire_counts)를 함께 읽을 것.

definitions.corrected_refusal: eval_refusal.string_matching_refused and matching_refusal_pattern_indices; stored refused_regex is ignored

interaction_sign.corrected_refusal: positive means a larger lens-associated refusal decrease than arm0
interaction_sign.sr_harm: negative means a larger lens-associated harm increase than arm0; the sign is intentionally not flipped

definitions.mixed_replication_warning: arm1/arm3 none, agreeable, agreeable_para1 have three treatment runs; arm0, arm2, and principled cells have one. n_runs and seeds must accompany means.
definitions.truncation_exclusion: cut-off continuations can receive harmful scores; exclusion is non-random. since R74 (2026-08-06) truncation-included is the headline for this cohort and excluded is kept as a conservative floor. the 512-token finish_reason measurement that licenses this ran on retrained checkpoints (see results/ckpt_identity_audit.json)
definitions.paired_tests: exact McNemar tests are descriptive and were not preregistered; p-values appear only in JSON
